hook: Your walk in Chefchaouen is a walk through blue.
title: The Moroccan Town Painted Blue
description:
Chefchaouen in northern Morocco is famous for its blue-painted walls, doors and stairs. Its old town is known as the Blue Pearl. India has a Blue City too, Jodhpur, but this one feels different. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Morocco #Chefchaouen
